# Freerouting

> Freerouting is a printed circuit board autorouter. It reads a Specctra design file (.dsn)
> exported from an EDA tool such as KiCad, routes the board, and writes a Specctra session file
> (.ses) to import back.

AI agents that run Freerouting should read the agent guide first. It ships inside the jar of every
version: `java -jar freerouting.jar --agent-guide` prints the guide that matches that jar.

- [Agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): how to start, watch and stop a run, which options to use,
  and how to read the log and the result file.
- [Settings reference](docs/settings.md): every option, its default, and when it helps.
- [Command line arguments](docs/command_line_arguments.md): the short flags (`-de`, `-do`, `-mt`,
  `-dct`).
- [MCP server](docs/API/MCP.md): Freerouting as a service for agents that talk MCP.
- [Scoring](docs/scoring.md): how the board score is computed.
